description.value: Sunshine Market is a neighbourhood grocery store in Kelowna's Lakeshore area, claiming the largest selection of Indian groceries in the city alongside fresh Okanagan produce sourced through direct farm partnerships. Beyond standard grocery staples, it runs a full grill and deli serving hot breakfasts, daily lunch specials, and Indian dishes such as butter chicken and chicken biryani. Touring cyclists can resupply with fresh fruit, ready-to-eat hot meals, specialty provisions, and baked goods all under one roof.
